thread:
sara: FYI FinEdge is seeing a large p99 latency spike that's starting to impact their SLA (alerts started ~09:16 UTC). Impacting tenant finedge-prod on POST /v1/generate. Need quick owners + mitigation steps. cc @mike @jas

mike: I'll take primary. @olivia can you own infra scaling/routing changes?

olivia: On it. Quick look shows a simultaneous traffic burst + longer token lengths from their traffic. I can push a temporary routing rule to route finedge-prod to gen-lite-v2 for requests <=512 tokens. That should cut tail.

jas: Agreed — enabling heavier prefix/KV caching for this tenant will also help. I'll prepare a small runtime hook to bump cache TTL for finedge-prod and open a PR.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued: infra/runtime-cache-routing-update for tenant= finedge-prod -> canary at ~09:36 UTC. React with :+1: to approve.

mike: Do we need any DB/schema work, or is this purely config/runtime?

olivia: Config/runtime only. No DB changes.

esther: Oncall — I'll temporarily increase autoscaler headroom for the model pool (+2 instances for 1 hour) as a bridge. Applying now.

devops: Re-route snippet I pushed to staging canary: 
```json
{
  "tenant": "finedge-prod",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model_fallback": "gen-lite-v2",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```
Pushed to canary, monitoring metrics.

jas: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823 — runtime hook + telemetry. Needs 1 review.

mike: @sara — can we tell CS/customer this is the mitigation path and give an ETA?

sara: Yes. Tell CS: mitigation deployed to canary and rolling; expect measurable improvement within 30-45m. I'll update the customer-facing note.

olivia: Canary results: p50 stable, p99 down ~60% in canary traffic. Rolling to 3/5 nodes now.

oncall-bot: Autoscaler adjustment (+2) applied to pool 'gen-prod-3' at 09:29 UTC by esther.

mike: Good progress. After we stabilize: must do RCA on token distribution change and consider longer-term dynamic routing by token distribution. I'll open Jira tickets.

sara: Add a short postmortem and action items (who will own follow-ups + timeline). Also schedule a sync with the FinEdge AE so they have a clear customer update.

mike: Will create INF-927 (mitigation recap) and INF-928 (dynamic routing RFC) — target RFC EOD tomorrow.

sara: Thanks everyone. I'll close loop with CS and update the incident doc. :pray:
